name: Covenants
overview: Scripture reveals that covenants are solemn agreements often established by God with His people, as seen in His promise to Noah and all living creatures that He would never again destroy the earth with a flood (Genesis 9:9-11). These covenants involve clear specifications and ceremonial acts, such as the offering of sacrifices and passing between divided pieces (Genesis 8:20; 15:9). They serve to establish friendship, peace, and mutual protection between parties, underscoring God's faithfulness and the serious commitment required in these divine and human agreements.
